package com.example.billing

import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.math.MathContext
import kotlin.math.round

fun InvoiceResponse.toInvoice(): Invoice = Invoice(
    id = invoiceId,
    issuedAt = issuedAt,
    dueDate = dueDate,
    status = toInvoiceStatus(status),
    total = if (totalCents > 0L) (round(totalCents.toDouble() / 100.0)).toBigDecimal() else BigDecimal("0"),
    currency = currency,
    notes = notes?.let { value -> value.toString() } ?: "none",
    customerId = customer.customerId,
    customerName = ("${customer.firstName.uppercase()}${" "}${customer.lastName}").trim(),
    customerEmail = customer.emailAddress,
    billingAddress = customer.billingAddress.toAddress(),
    items = lines.map { it.toInvoiceItem() },
    isPaid = paid,
    createdBy = "importer",
)

fun BillingAddress.toAddress(): Address = Address(
    street = street,
    city = city,
    postalCode = zipCode,
    countryCode = TODO("No value for countryCode in the mapping"),
)

fun Line.toInvoiceItem(): InvoiceItem = InvoiceItem(
    sku = sku,
    description = description,
    quantity = qty.toInt(),
    unitPrice = unitPriceCents.toBigDecimal().divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(100L), MathContext.DECIMAL128),
    taxRate = taxRate.toDouble(),
)

private fun toInvoiceStatus(value: String): InvoiceStatus = when (value) {
    "paid" -> InvoiceStatus.PAID
    else -> InvoiceStatus.DRAFT
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

final class InvoiceResponseMapper
{
    public static function toInvoice(array $source): Invoice
    {
        return new Invoice(
            id: $source['invoice_id'],
            issuedAt: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['issued_at']),
            dueDate: new \DateTimeImmutable($source['due_date']),
            status: self::toInvoiceStatus($source['status']),
            total: $source['total_cents'] > 0 ? round((float) $source['total_cents'] / 100.0) : 0.0,
            currency: $source['currency'],
            notes: ($source['notes'] ?? null) === null ? null : (string) ($source['notes'] ?? null) ?? 'none',
            customerId: $source['customer']['customer_id'],
            customerName: trim((string) mb_strtoupper($source['customer']['first_name']) . (string) (' ') . (string) $source['customer']['last_name']),
            customerEmail: $source['customer']['email_address'],
            billingAddress: self::toAddress($source['customer']['billing_address']),
            items: array_map(self::toInvoiceItem(...), $source['lines']),
            isPaid: $source['paid'],
            createdBy: 'importer',
        );
    }

    public static function toAddress(array $source): Address
    {
        return new Address(
            street: $source['street'],
            city: $source['city'],
            postalCode: $source['zip_code'],
            countryCode: throw new \LogicException('No value for countryCode in the mapping'),
        );
    }

    public static function toInvoiceItem(array $source): InvoiceItem
    {
        return new InvoiceItem(
            sku: $source['sku'],
            description: $source['description'],
            quantity: $source['qty'],
            unitPrice: ((float) $source['unit_price_cents']) / 100,
            taxRate: $source['tax_rate'],
        );
    }

    private static function toInvoiceStatus(string $value): InvoiceStatus
    {
        return match ($value) {
            'paid' => InvoiceStatus::PAID,
            default => InvoiceStatus::DRAFT,
        };
    }
}
